_comment: Community Piper voices, curated by hand; tools/regen_voices.py merges them into manifest.json.
Each is pinned to a Hugging Face revision, so the files can't change under us; the add-on checks the model's sha256.
To add one: the licence must be stated on the model card AND allow commercial use, the training data must be named
with its own licence, no game/celebrity/cloned voices, phoneme type espeak (or another piper-tts 1.8.0 handles), and it
must synthesize through piper-tts. Seen on piperhub.org (2026-10-20) and checked there: see README's Community voices.
